scope: Available local Frostwatch-directory sessions and the confirmed original creation workspace (10 September new-chat); includes historical subagent/reviewer tasks and preliminary setup or ancillary work within these sessions. Not a clean per-feature meter; missing/deleted/remote logs are not covered.
time_definition: Union of recorded task-start/task-complete intervals, plus the current active task to the snapshot. Includes model/tool/build/test/wait time inside active turns. Excludes gaps between turns. Not GPU compute time or human labour hours. Unfinished historical tasks without an end are excluded.
